From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rebecca Long <rebecca.long@brightskyhealth.com>
Cc: BrightSky Health PM Team <pm@brightskyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: BrightSky Health — Activation owners, initial risks, and immediate asks

Hi team —

Wrapping up the post-sign handoff for BrightSky (signed 8/24). Quick summary of the deal and the immediate items we need to lock in so we can meet the 10/15 pilot go-live target: 

- Deal highlights: 12-month contract, Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity), intent to push to Private (VPC) in Q4 if pilot looks good.
- Committed SLOs in SOW: 99.9% uptime for production, 95th p50 token latency targets (see SOW).
- Key external contacts: Rebecca Long (PM), Chris Hsu (CTO, cc future), legal@brightskyhealth.com for procurement redlines.

Immediate asks / owner map (please confirm):
1) Project lead / primary CS owner: Tessa (handoff kickoff, weekly cadence) — owner: Tessa Morgan
2) Solutions / on-call for model routing & infra: Karthik (staging verification + kernel selection verification) — owner: Karthik Iyer
3) Customer success escalation & account strategy: Grace (renewal/expansion lens) — owner: Grace O'Connor

Risk / open items:
- Procurement: BrightSky asked for a standard security addendum and a one-week extension on the payment term; legal is reviewing redlines (I attached the SOW and the initial activation checklist).
- VPC requirements: BrightSky flagged IP allowlists and a locked-down egress policy that may require a short design session with our Private team.
- Dataset access: they will not provide production data for pilot; will use a sanitized subset. Need to confirm whether that affects our default KV-cache sizing and batch profiles.

Attachments: BrightSky_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with SLOs & pricing), activation-checklist.xlsx (initial owner-level checklist).

Next steps I propose this week:
- Tessa: confirm kickoff window (propose 9/2 or 9/3) and owner roster for recurring standups.
- Karthik: confirm staging credentials are acceptable and whether we need an early kernel/quantization call.
- Legal / Sales: I'll push for an accelerated redline turn (cc'd legal separately).

Rebecca — feel free to add any other priorities I've missed.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
